title: Cylindrical base
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop which consists of the first circle centered at coordinates [0.0117, 0.0117] with a radius of 0.0117. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0234. Rotate the scaled sketch using the previously defined Euler angles and translate it using the specified translation vector. Extrude the transformed sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to form a solid body. The resulting cylindrical base has a length of 0.0234375 units, a width of 0.0234375 units, and a height of 0.75 units. This cylindrical base serves as the foundation for the subsequent parts of the model.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular sketch for the top face of the cylinder
sketch = workplane.center(0.0117, 0.0117).circle(0.0117)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical section
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Scale the sketch to create the rectangular section at the top
scaled_sketch = workplane.center(0.0117, 0.0117).rect(0.0234, 0.0234)

# Extrude the scaled sketch to create the rectangular section
rectangular_section = scaled_sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Combine the cylindrical section and the rectangular section
combined = cylinder.union(rectangular_section)

# Final model
r = combined

# Display the final model
